    "# TFT Match Data — Exploratory Data Analysis"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,

   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import pandas as pd\\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\\n",
    "import seaborn as sns\\n",
    "\\n",
    "sns.set_theme\(style=\\"whitegrid\\"\)\\n",
    "\\n",
    "df = pd.read_csv\(\\"data/match_data.csv\\"\)\\n",
    "print\(f\\"Shape: {df.shape[0]} rows, {df.shape[1]} columns\\"\)\\n",
    "df.head\(\)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Data Overview"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "df.info\(\)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "df.describe\(\)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Missing Values"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "missing = df.isnull\(\).sum\(\)\\n",
    "missing_pct = \(missing / len\(df\) * 100\).round\(1\)\\n",
    "missing_df = pd.DataFrame\({\\"count\\": missing, \\"pct\\": missing_pct}\)\\n",
    "missing_df = missing_df[missing_df[\\"count\\"] > 0].sort_values\(\\"pct\\", ascending=False\)\\n",
    "\\n",
    "print\(f\\"{len\(missing_df\)} columns have missing values out of {df.shape[1]}\\"\)\\n",
    "missing_df.head\(20\)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots\(figsize=\(12, 5\)\)\\n",
    "missing_df.head\(30\)[\\"pct\\"].plot\(kind=\\"bar\\", ax=ax\)\\n",
    "ax.set_title\(\\"Top 30 Columns by Missing %\\"\)\\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel\(\\"Missing %\\"\)\\n",
    "plt.xticks\(rotation=45, ha=\\"right\\"\)\\n",
    "plt.tight_layout\(\)\\n",
    "plt.savefig\(\\"eda/missing_values.png\\", dpi=150\)\\n",
    "plt.show\(\)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Placement Distribution"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots\(figsize=\(8, 5\)\)\\n",
    "df[\\"placement\\"].value_counts\(\).sort_index\(\).plot\(kind=\\"bar\\", ax=ax, color=\\"steelblue\\"\)\\n",
    "ax.set_title\(\\"Placement Distribution\\"\)\\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel\(\\"Placement\\"\)\\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel\(\\"Count\\"\)\\n",
    "plt.tight_layout\(\)\\n",
    "plt.savefig\(\\"eda/placement_distribution.png\\", dpi=150\)\\n",
    "plt.show\(\)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Numeric Features vs Placement"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "numeric_cols = [\\"level\\", \\"gold_left\\", \\"last_round\\", \\"time_eliminated\\",\\n",
    "                \\"total_damage_to_players\\", \\"players_eliminated\\"]\\n",
    "\\n",
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots\(2, 3, figsize=\(15, 9\)\)\\n",
    "for ax, col in zip\(axes.flat, numeric_cols\):\\n",
    "    df.groupby\(\\"placement\\"\)[col].mean\(\).plot\(kind=\\"bar\\", ax=ax, color=\\"steelblue\\"\)\\n",
    "    ax.set_title\(f\\"Avg {col} by Placement\\"\)\\n",
    "    ax.set_ylabel\(col\)\\n",
    "plt.tight_layout\(\)\\n",
    "plt.savefig\(\\"eda/numeric_vs_placement.png\\", dpi=150\)\\n",
    "plt.show\(\)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots\(2, 3, figsize=\(15, 9\)\)\\n",
    "for ax, col in zip\(axes.flat, numeric_cols\):\\n",
    "    sns.boxplot\(data=df, x=\\"placement\\", y=col, ax=ax\)\\n",
    "    ax.set_title\(col\)\\n",
    "plt.tight_layout\(\)\\n",
    "plt.savefig\(\\"eda/numeric_boxplots.png\\", dpi=150\)\\n",
    "plt.show\(\)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Trait Analysis"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "trait_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c.startswith\(\\"trait_\\"\)]\\n",
    "print\(f\\"{len\(trait_cols\)} trait columns\\"\)\\n",
    "\\n",
    "# Most common traits \(by non-null count\)\\n",
    "trait_presence = df[trait_cols].notna\(\).sum\(\).sort_values\(ascending=False\)\\n",
    "\\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots\(figsize=\(12, 5\)\)\\n",
    "trait_presence.head\(20\).plot\(kind=\\"bar\\", ax=ax, color=\\"coral\\"\)\\n",
    "ax.set_title\(\\"Top 20 Most Common Traits\\"\)\\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel\(\\"# Games Present\\"\)\\n",
    "plt.xticks\(rotation=45, ha=\\"right\\"\)\\n",
    "plt.tight_layout\(\)\\n",
    "plt.savefig\(\\"eda/top_traits.png\\", dpi=150\)\\n",
    "plt.show\(\)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Average placement when a trait is active\\n",
    "trait_avg_placement = {}\\n",
    "for col in trait_cols:\\n",
    "    mask = df[col].notna\(\) & \(df[col] > 0\)\\n",
    "    if mask.sum\(\) >= 50:  # at least 50 games\\n",
    "        trait_avg_placement[col] = df.loc[mask, \\"placement\\"].mean\(\)\\n",
    "\\n",
    "trait_placement_df = pd.Series\(trait_avg_placement\).sort_values\(\)\\n",
    "\\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots\(figsize=\(12, 6\)\)\\n",
    "trait_placement_df.plot\(kind=\\"barh\\", ax=ax, color=\\"steelblue\\"\)\\n",
    "ax.axvline\(x=4.5, color=\\"red\\", linestyle=\\"--\\", label=\\"avg \(4.5\)\\"\)\\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel\(\\"Avg Placement \(lower = better\)\\"\)\\n",
    "ax.set_title\(\\"Average Placement by Trait \(min 50 games\)\\"\)\\n",
    "ax.legend\(\)\\n",
    "plt.tight_layout\(\)\\n",
    "plt.savefig\(\\"eda/trait_avg_placement.png\\", dpi=150\)\\n",
    "plt.show\(\)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Unit Analysis"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Gather all unit names across unit slots\\n",
    "unit_name_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c.endswith\(\\"_name\\"\)]\\n",
    "all_units = df[unit_name_cols].values.flatten\(\)\\n",
    "all_units = pd.Series\(all_units\).dropna\(\)\\n",
    "\\n",
    "unit_counts = all_units.value_counts\(\)\\n",
    "print\(f\\"{len\(unit_counts\)} unique units\\"\)\\n",
    "\\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots\(figsize=\(12, 5\)\)\\n",
    "unit_counts.head\(20\).plot\(kind=\\"bar\\", ax=ax, color=\\"mediumseagreen\\"\)\\n",
    "ax.set_title\(\\"Top 20 Most Played Units\\"\)\\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel\(\\"Times Fielded\\"\)\\n",
    "plt.xticks\(rotation=45, ha=\\"right\\"\)\\n",
    "plt.tight_layout\(\)\\n",
    "plt.savefig\(\\"eda/top_units.png\\", dpi=150\)\\n",
    "plt.show\(\)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Correlation Heatmap"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "core_cols = [\\"placement\\"] + numeric_cols\\n",
    "corr = df[core_cols].corr\(\)\\n",
    "\\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots\(figsize=\(8, 6\)\)\\n",
    "sns.heatmap\(corr, annot=True, fmt=\\".2f\\", cmap=\\"coolwarm\\", center=0, ax=ax\)\\n",
    "ax.set_title\(\\"Correlation Matrix — Core Numeric Features\\"\)\\n",
    "plt.tight_layout\(\)\\n",
    "plt.savefig\(\\"eda/correlation_heatmap.png\\", dpi=150\)\\n",
    "plt.show\(\)"
   ]
  }
